title: Hogwarts Spell Cluster
premise: A one-screen magical bubble shooter reimagined as a Hogwarts spell-combination trial where the player aims a wand-guided orb into suspended enchanted clusters to dispel curses before magical instability reaches the caster line.
interaction_model: Drag or touch to aim a shot upward, release to fire a single enchanted orb that bounces off walls and snaps into a staggered grid, forming same-type groups of three or more.
objective: Clear the hanging magical cluster by creating matches of three or more same-type spell orbs, trigger floating cluster drops for bonus points, and prevent the cursed formation from reaching the lower danger threshold.
progression: Core gameplay remains a looping one-screen arcade puzzle shooter, but the remixed identity frames progress as a five-stage Hogwarts arc from introductory charm practice to dangerous forbidden chamber dispelling, with each level represented through safe presentation and intensity evolution rather than new mechanics.
theme: Harry Potter inspired wizard school spellcasting, enchanted chambers, magical lessons, house-color energy, cursed relics, moving candlelight, and mystical storm pressure.
mood: Whimsical magical tension with rising enchanted danger, readable arcade urgency, and celebratory spell-combo payoff.
likely_audience: Players who enjoy casual arcade puzzle games, bubble shooters, mobile-friendly matching games, and recognizable fantasy-school wizard themes.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the implemented game is a bubble-shooter style arcade puzzle game.
High confidence that theme can be changed safely without altering mechanics.
Moderate confidence that five-level progression should be conceptual/presentation-led in this stage because explicit level code is not yet present.
source_game_summary: The source game is a full-screen canvas bubble shooter with a staggered hanging grid, drag-to-aim release shooting, wall bounce, match-3 popping, floating-cluster drops, score tracking, start/game-over overlays, and immediate restart when the board is cleared.
remix_prompt_interpretation: The Harry Potter prompt should be executed as a Hogwarts magical trial reskin rather than a broad franchise rewrite. The most compatible mapping is wand-guided spell orb shooting in enchanted chambers, preserving the puzzle board and score loop exactly.
preserve_elements: drag to aim and release to fire
loss when the cluster reaches too low
start, play, and game-over state flow
transform_elements: launcher into wand focus or spell pedestal
particle effects into sparks, glyphs, and magical embers
audio into approved mystical / magical-feeling catalog choices
feedback GIFs into approved celebratory / warning magical-adjacent reactions
recreation_prompt: Create a mobile-friendly one-screen Harry Potter-inspired bubble shooter set inside Hogwarts-style magical chambers. The player drags to aim a wand-guided enchanted orb and releases to fire it upward into a hanging staggered grid of floating spell clusters. Shots bounce off side walls, snap into the grid, and clear connected groups of three or more matching magical orb types. Unsupported clusters drop for bonus points. The player loses if the cursed formation reaches too low near the caster line, and the board loops into a fresh round whenever fully cleared. Use start and game-over overlays, a simple score HUD, a mute control, magical combo feedback, and strong procedural wizarding visuals such as candlelit halls, glyph circles, enchanted windows, potion glow, sparks, and storm-lit castle ambience. Preserve the exact arcade puzzle mechanics and scoring behavior while making the presentation clearly feel like a Hogwarts spell trial that can scale across five recognizable magical lesson worlds.
